title: Upgrade workers to Pi 1.0 (cloud image and local pi profiles)
description: Pi 1.0 shipped 2026-10-01 (https://earendil.com/posts/pi-1-0/, MIT): first stable release; Codemode (MCP and non-LLM models like Jev native), extension support for virtual models, deferred tool loading, mid-conversation system messages (transcript-aware prompt/tool changes — useful for report-linter pushback #183 and stuck nudges), new TUI, fullscreen by default. Upgrade the pi in image/Dockerfile (cloud workers) and whatever local pi the herdr/subprocess profiles run; review breaking changes against image/worker.sh (session resume flags, --approve, print/headless mode, provider config for cloudflare-workers-ai/* via the gateway), profiles-*/ and the pushback path; keep Workers-AI-only in the cloud.
acceptance_criteria: [1] Image builds with Pi 1.0; internal/sandboximage tests and a real worker probe (ticks-worker --probe on staging) pass. [2] Local pi profiles run Pi 1.0; the pushback/resume paths are tested. [3] make gate passes; merged only when no epic run is live (or the live run is unaffected).
closed_reason: superseded by epic 43y (pi-durable replaces the pi CLI worker path; operator 2026-10-04)
